prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1048; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the trunk lid shows a crease along the upper edge, consistent with a rear-end impact. The left taillight assembly is cracked, and the rear quarter panel has a shallow dent near the wheel well. Some of the lower bumper brackets may be bent, but it is not clear whether all of this damage came from this impact. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours are a little high for this scope of work and should be reviewed. The invoices show no repeated charges. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
